goal: Container scan gate: images with exploitable critical findings blocked before deployment.
use: Container scan gate: images with exploitable critical findings blocked before deployment. Use when a container image is built for deployment.

steps.note: Confirm the scan runs on each image build, before it is pushed.
Set the rule. An exploitable critical finding blocks the push.
Check the base image. Flag images built on an unsupported base.
Check exceptions. Each accepted finding needs an owner and an expiry.
Report. The image, the findings, the decision and the owner.
